label: Immanuel Kant, Critique of Pure Reason…: Temporal succession of opposite states does not by itself…
locator: Fourth Antinomy, thesis/antithesis and observations, A458–460/B486–488; paragraph “In the pure sense of the categories”
interpretation: Kant’s criticism of the inference from empirical to intelligible contingency, not an assertion that every changing thing is metaphysically necessary. The separate model tests only this inferential insufficiency.
